messages.content:
[Dina Levačić becomes first person in world to swim around Saint Helena | Croatia Week] https://www.croatiaweek.com/dina-levacic-first-circumnavigation-saint-helena Levačić successfully swam around the remote South Atlantic island, a distance of approximately 48 kilometres, finishing the challenge in 17 hours and 13 minutes. She entered the water at 00:01 local time on Thursday, 26 February 2026 (01:01 Croatian time). The swim both started and finished at Landing Steps in Jamestown, marking a complete loop of the island’s rugged coastline. [...] Croatia Week Home » Sport » Dina Levačić becomes first person in world to swim around Saint Helena # Dina Levačić becomes first person in world to swim around Saint Helena by croatiaweek in Sport Dina Levačić (Photo: Private album) Croatian long-distance swimmer Dina Levačić has made history by becoming the first person in the world to complete a full circumnavigation swim of Saint Helena. [...] There were no previous official records of a full circumnavigation swim around Saint Helena Island. By completing the demanding route, Levačić has become the first swimmer ever to achieve the feat. Saint Helena is a remote volcanic island located roughly 1,950 kilometres west of the south-western coast of Africa and about 4,000 kilometres east of Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. (Photo: Private album)
[Go Swimming! ⋅ Saint Helena Island Info ⋅ About St Helena, in the South Atlantic Ocean] https://sainthelenaisland.info/swimming.htm The second round-the-island swim (and the first one organised by Open Water Africa) was completed on 26`th` February 2026 by Dina Levačić in 17h 13m, for which she was awarded the Governor’s Medal. The first male round-the-island swim was completed on 11`th` March 2026 by Angus McPherson in a time of 20h 7m 3s; this was promptly beaten on 19`th` March 2026 in a time of 16h 50m 42s by Ryan Stramrood. [...] A second round-the-island swim was completed on 26`th` February 2026 by Dina Levačić, supported by Open Water A
